items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-07-17
items.q: Ridgely did Tra-la-la, and Dave and I did it, and leased it to Decca Records.

ctx.x: Yeah. You know, come to think of it. And Dave's big band.

Sure, that's right. You had to do all those sides like with Dave Bartholomew with the big band. Yeah. So when you only had four, how would you do, how would you do, if you had only four, how would you do a big band?
